purpose: Official live WFS alternatives for two currently imported DB-backed cities; opt-in descriptors only.
storage: Metadata and bounded acceptance results only. No upstream polygons, owner data, addresses, credentials or database writes.
method: Two 3x3 grids of .0025-degree cells, second grid shifted .004 degrees in both axes; forced 25-row pages; all retained native keys queried in batches of at most 80; production 500-row pages and genuine parcel footprint round trip.
scope: Acceptance is limited to the tested viewports and published city scope. It is not a claim of complete national or citywide coverage.

descriptors.name: GURS cadastral parcels — Ljubljana
descriptors.scope: Official GURS cadastral parcel service; acceptance evidence covers bounded Ljubljana cells only, not national completeness.
descriptors.attribution: Geodetska uprava Republike Slovenije (GURS), cadastral parcels. Adapted to WGS84.
descriptors.licenceNote: GURS source conditions remain informational. No ownership or personal fields are retained by this descriptor.

descriptors.name: IDECABA cadastral parcels — Buenos Aires
descriptors.scope: Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires cadastral parcel layer; bounded samples verified, not Greater Buenos Aires or Argentina.
descriptors.attribution: Gobierno de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires, IDECABA cadastral parcel layer. Adapted to WGS84.
descriptors.licenceNote: The previously checked catalogue stated CC-BY-2.5-AR; it is historical evidence, not a fresh terms verification. Source conditions remain informational.

evidence.observation: Published EID_PARCELA is imported directly into eid_parcela.
Current parcel route prefixes the same eid_parcela with SI-.

ljubljana.precision: 18-digit published EID must remain a string; it exceeds JavaScript safe integer precision.

buenos_aires.reason: The published WFS nam has a two-digit section while the existing import builds three-digit-section SMP. Three EPOK lookups corroborate matching codes, but a complete bijective native mapping and geometry equivalence have not been verified. The live namespace therefore retains nam exactly and does not alias or replace AR-<smp>.

evidence.observation: SMP combines formattedSection, blockStr and formattedParcel.
Current route prefixes imported SMP with AR-.

buenos_aires.transportFeatureId: Ephemeral WFS fid and gid are not canonical identifiers.

safeguards: Missing native IDs never fall back to WFS row IDs.
Incomplete pages, changing matched counts and conflicting native-key geometry fail closed.
Foreign canonical namespaces are rejected before fetching.
Only allowlisted parcel source fields survive canonicalization.

integration: Merge reviewed descriptors into the executable source catalogue, resolve existing DB-vs-live city routing explicitly, and add catalog/source-binding city fixtures. Generic createWfsParcelSource already implements these sources; no provider transport wrapper or database ingestion is required.
